name: viral-producer-allinone
description: All-in-one open-source viral video producer: carries all 5 production skills for offline use, plus a self-update skill that refreshes the whole pipeline from GitHub. One zip, one upload, everything included.

profession.zh: 开源爆款短视频制片人（可自我更新）

displayDescription.en: Carries all 5 skills for offline use, and can refresh itself from GitHub when online. One upload covers every machine.
displayDescription.zh: 自带全部 5 个技能离线可用，联网时还能从 GitHub 自我更新。传一次，所有电脑都能用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我抓最近 7 天爆火的开源项目，挑最适合大众的一个，写一份能直接开拍的短视频分镜脚本。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Fetch this week's hottest GitHub projects, pick the one with the broadest appeal, and write me a shoot-ready short-video storyboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我抓最近 7 天爆火的开源项目，挑最适合大众的一个，写一份能直接开拍的短视频分镜脚本。
quickPrompts.en: Fetch this week's hottest GitHub projects, pick the one with the broadest appeal, and write me a shoot-ready short-video storyboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这条生产线更新到 GitHub 上的最新版。
quickPrompts.en: Refresh this pipeline to the latest version on GitHub.

quickPrompts.zh: 照这个 GitHub 项目链接，给我出一版完整的短视频分镜脚本。
quickPrompts.en: Take this GitHub project link and produce a full short-video storyboard for it.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份脚本的口播去一遍 AI 味，并做 4 字/秒语速校验。
quickPrompts.en: De-AI-polish the narration in this script and run a 4-chars-per-second speech-rate check.
